text:
Ava (partnerships): quick sync — vendors pushed overlapping launch windows for H100 refresh, H200 beta, MI300 revC and Gaudi2 this quarter. want to align marketplace & SI enablement dates. who can join a 30m slot tomorrow?
Ravi (product): i can. need to lock announcement embargo windows first.
Jing (eng-runtime): echo — we need driver/abi freeze dates. eng needs at least 3 weeks before GA to run perf regressions.
Carlos (partners-na): NVIDIA wants a co-announcement tentatively 2026-05-12 but flexible. Habana/Gaudi team suggested week of 05/19. AMD MI300 team said late-May.
Mei (sales): sales needs marketplace SKUs live + sample invoices by GA day. if marketplace listing lags we lose early deals.
Ava (partnerships): proposed plan: (1) lock vendor embargo windows this week, (2) set internal freeze dates, (3) publish marketplace rollout cadence + SI enablement calendar. can we draft a combined timeline in the meeting? :calendar:
Jing (eng-runtime): i'll bring the test matrix and perf baseline. quick ask — do we treat H200 as drop-in for H100 paths or separate profiles?
Ravi (product): separate profiles. H200 has different mem configs; runtime needs a tuning profile. we'll document fallbacks to H100 variant for the hosted tier.
Carlos (partners-na): vendors will require partner logos + partner brief 72h before any press. also certification checklist from SI teams.
Mei (sales): add SKU mapping: hosted API tier, dedicated reservation SKU, private deployment bundle. we should map them to vendor SKUs in the marketplace draft.
Ava (partnerships): action items pre-meeting: Jing — driver/abi freeze dates + quick perf delta table. Ravi — embargo windows per vendor (NVIDIA, AMD, Habana) and suggested announcement dates. Carlos — partner PR constraints and SI readiness checklist. Mei — marketplace SKUs draft. i'll consolidate.
Jing (eng-runtime): ack. tentative driver freeze dates: NVIDIA 2026-04-20, AMD 2026-04-26, Habana 2026-05-02. will confirm in meeting.
Ravi (product): noted. also need to decide canary rollout strategy: 10% hosted traffic -> 25% -> GA. prefer to coordinate canary with vendor patch releases.
Carlos (partners-na): vendors asked for a joint canary window of at least 2 weeks. they want telemetry access for regressions (we'll share aggregated metrics only).
Mei (sales): question: marketplace listing timelines require ~5 business days for cloud partner approval. factor that into the cadence.
Ava (partnerships): good point. propose these milestone dates (draft):
- 2026-04-20: internal driver/abi freeze start
- 2026-04-27: vendor embargo windows finalized
- 2026-05-04: SI certification kick-off
- 2026-05-12 -> 05-26: staggered vendor co-announcements (NVIDIA mid-May, AMD late-May, Habana late-May)
- 2026-05-27: marketplace listings live (target)
- 2026-06-10: GA + full rollout
Ravi (product): looks tight but OK if vendors commit. need a contingency if MI300 slips.
Jing (eng-runtime): contingency idea: fallback model variants + quantized builds to reduce perf variance. also prefix cache warmup plan for canary.
Carlos (partners-na): PR ask — vendors want to sign-off on joint copy 48h before announce. put that in calendar invites.
Mei (sales): will prep marketplace SKU spreadsheet. tagging dependencies: billing, legal, portal.
Ava (partnerships): if everyone's good i will schedule a 30m sync tomorrow 09:30 PT. calendar-bot, send invite to @Ravi @Jing @Carlos @Mei and attach draft timeline. :sparkles:
calendar-bot: Invite created: "Vendor launch cadence sync — H100/H200/MI300/Gaudi2" 2026-04-07 09:30 PT. attachment: https://drive.internal/redwood/partnerships/vendor-timeline-draft.xlsx
Ravi (product): TY. please include agenda: embargo + freeze dates, marketplace gating, SI checklist, canary plan.
Jing (eng-runtime): will add perf test checklist to the drive.
Carlos (partners-na): will share vendor PR constraints doc.
Mei (sales): added initial SKU mapping to the sheet.
Ava (partnerships): one more: let's capture pinned model versions for Dedicated vs Hosted (customers will expect parity notes). add that as agenda item.
Ravi (product): good call. also add a quick decision on whether to support Gaudi2 in Dedicated day 1 or later.
Jing (eng-runtime): technically doable for day 1 if vendor toolchain arrives week earlier. need resource ops sign-off.
Ava (partnerships): ok — meeting tomorrow to decide. thanks all. :thumbsup:
